effects.printed_clause: Cannot be Normal Summoned unless you control a Ghostrick monster; once per turn, you can change this card to face-down Defense Position.

effects.printed_clause: If you Set a monster(s) or Special Summon a Ghostrick monster(s): You can Special Summon this card from your hand in face-down Defense Position.
effects.lua_implementation: The Set and Ghostrick Special Summon trigger clones no longer carry an unprinted hard once-per-turn; each eligible copy may trigger as written.

effects.lua_implementation: The flip trigger announces Level 1 through 4 and targets any number of face-up Level-bearing Ghostrick monsters without an unprinted hard once-per-turn.

effects.lua_implementation: An EFFECT_TYPE_XMATERIAL Quick Effect detaches one material as cost, targets a face-up opponent monster able to turn Set, and changes it to face-down Defense Position; SetCountLimit(1) is soft per host Xyz.
